cards.ex: My grandma passed down her recipes to me.
cards.exUz: Buвим менинг бувим рецептларини менга мерос килди.
cards.uzDef: Avloddan avlodga yetkazmoq, meros qoldirmoq.

cards.ex: We try to keep the tradition alive by celebrating it every year.
cards.exUz: Биз анъанани хар йили нишонлаб, уни саклаб колишга харакат киламиз.
cards.uzDef: Yo'qolib ketishiga yo'l qo'ymaslik, esda saqlamoq.

cards.ex: The old city is a significant part of our cultural heritage.
cards.exUz: Эски шахар бизнинг маданий меросимизнинг мухим кисмидир.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdan qolgan madaniy boyliklar, an'analar.

cards.ex: They uphold the tradition of celebrating the harvest.
cards.exUz: Улар хосилни нишонлаш анъанасини куллаб-кувватлашади.
cards.uzDef: An'anaga sodiq qolish, uni himoya qilish.

cards.ex: The festival gives everyone a sense of belonging.
cards.exUz: Фестивал хамма кишига мансублик хиссини беради.
cards.uzDef: Bir guruhga, jamiyatga mansub ekanlik hissi.

cards.ex: There's often a generation gap in opinions about music.
cards.exUz: Мусика хакида турли авлодларнинг фикрларида фарк бор.
cards.uzDef: Turli avlodlarning qadriyatlari, qarashlari o'rtasidagi tafovut.

cards.ex: His cultural identity is very important to him.
cards.exUz: Унинг маданий ўзлиги у учун жуда мухимдир.
cards.uzDef: Madaniyatga mansublik hissi, o'ziga xoslik.

cards.ex: We always get together for Thanksgiving.
cards.exUz: Биз доим Рахмат кунида йиғиламиз.
cards.uzDef: Uchrashmoq, birga vaqt o'tkazmoq, jamlanmoq.

cards.ex: We try to stick to our family traditions.
cards.exUz: Биз оилавий анъаналаримизга риоя қилишга харакат киламиз.
cards.uzDef: Qoidaga, rejaga yoki an'anaga sodiq qolmoq.

cards.ex: Graduation is a common rite of passage.
cards.exUz: Укишни тугатиш одатий утиш маросимидир.
cards.uzDef: Hayotning muhim bosqichini nishonlash marosimi.

cards.ex: The program promotes cultural exchange between countries.
cards.exUz: Дастур мамлакатлар уртасида маданий алмашинувни таргиб килади.
cards.uzDef: Turli madaniyatlar o'rtasida tajriba, bilim almashish.

cards.ex: That belief is very deep-rooted in their culture.
cards.exUz: Бу эътикод уларнинг маданиятида жуда чукур илдиз отган.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqtdan beri mavjud bo'lgan, mustahkam o'rnashgan.

cards.ex: The city is known for its cultural diversity.
cards.exUz: Шахар уз маданий хилма-хиллиги билан машхурдир.
cards.uzDef: Turli madaniyatlar va etnik guruhlarning mavjudligi.

cards.ex: They're carrying on the family business.
cards.exUz: Улар оилавий бизнесни давом эттиришяпти.
cards.uzDef: Boshlagan ishni davom ettirmoq, saqlab qolmoq.

cards.ex: He's a traditionalist at heart.
cards.exUz: У калбан анъанапараст.
cards.uzDef: Aslida, mohiyatan, ich-ichidan.

cards.ex: I'm here speaking on behalf of my community.
cards.exUz: Мен бу ерга жамиятим номидан гапириш учун келдим.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir o'rniga, kimningdir vakili sifatida.

cards.ex: The concert is a popular cultural event.
cards.exUz: Концерт машхур маданий тадбирдир.
cards.uzDef: Madaniyat bilan bog'liq bo'lgan tadbir, festival.

cards.ex: It's a social norm to greet people when you meet them.
cards.exUz: Одамлар билан учрашганда саломлашиш ижтимоий меъёрдир.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatda qabul qilingan xulq-atvor qoidalari.

cards.ex: The story has been told generation after generation.
cards.exUz: Бу хикоя авлоддан авлодга сузлаб келинмокда.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqtdan beri, doimiy ravishda.

cards.ex: I want to get in touch with my roots.
cards.exUz: Мен уз илдизларим билан алокага чикмокчиман.
cards.uzDef: Kim bilandir bog'lanmoq, xabar almashmoq.

cards.ex: It's easy to lose touch with your culture when you move away.
cards.exUz: Узокка кучиб кетганда уз маданиятингиз билан алокани узиш осон.
cards.uzDef: Kim bilandir aloqani yo'qotmoq.

cards.ex: He decided to break with tradition and get married abroad.
cards.exUz: У анъанадан воз кечиб, чет элда турмуш куришга карор килди.
cards.uzDef: An'anaga zid ish qilmoq, uni buzmoq.

cards.ex: By all accounts, the festival was a great success.
cards.exUz: Хамманинг фикрига кура, фестивал жуда муваффакиятли утди.
cards.uzDef: Hamma aytishicha, odamlarning fikriga ko'ra.

cards.ex: You should be aware of cultural norms when you travel.
cards.exUz: Саёхат килаётганда маданий меъёрлардан хабардор булишингиз керак.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan madaniyatda qabul qilingan xulq-atvor qoidalari.

cards.ex: Her cultural background influenced her art.
cards.exUz: Унинг маданий келиб чикиши унинг санъатига таъсир килди.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsning madaniy, etnik va ijtimoiy ildizlari.

cards.ex: We organized the event in the spirit of cultural exchange.
cards.exUz: Биз тадбирни маданий алмашинув рухида ташкиллаштирдик.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga mos ravishda, shunga o'xshab.

cards.ex: His views are often at odds with the older generation.
cards.exUz: Унинг карашлари купинча катта авлоднинг карашларига карама-карши.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga zid, mos kelmaydigan.

cards.ex: This tradition comes from a very old culture.
cards.exUz: Бу анъана жуда кадимги маданиятдан келиб чиккан.
cards.uzDef: Biror joydan yoki madaniyatdan kelib chiqmoq.

cards.ex: Immigration can change the social fabric of a country.
cards.exUz: Иммиграция мамлакатнинг ижтимоий тузилишини узгартириши мумкин.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatning asosiy tuzilishi, aloqalari va qadriyatlari.

cards.ex: Don't believe that; it's just an old wives' tale.
cards.exUz: Бунга ишонманг, бу шунчаки булмагур гап.
cards.uzDef: Asossiz, eski, ishonchsiz gap yoki e'tiqod.
